## PlaylistResourceClient.search() method

search a playlist for tracks matching the search string. Identical to entering search text in the Search field.

**Signature:**

```typescript
search(sourceId: string, persistentID: string, _for: string, only?: string, options?: CallOptions): Promise<void>;
```
